papers.title_en: Quantum circuits of elastic wave equations via Schrödingerisation
papers.evidence: 薛定谔化将线性偏微分方程转化为可幺正演化的薛定谔型系统并构建量子线路
papers.tldr: 弹性波方程数值模拟对地震成像等应用重要，但经典求解随空间分辨率提高代价高昂。本文用Schrödingerisation将均匀介质速度-应力方程化为酉演化，并结合Fourier谱与交错网格有限差分构造显式量子线路。分析Trotter-Suzuki分裂误差与CNOT门数，显示空间分辨率依赖较经典分区方法有多项式改进。无噪声模拟验证了受迫周期和阻抗边界问题的构造与误差。
papers.abstract_en: We construct explicit quantum circuits for the velocity-stress formulation of elastic wave equations in homogeneous media using Schrödingerisation. After rewriting the equations in symmetric matrix form(SMF), we use Fourier spectral discretization for source-driven periodic problems and staggered-grid finite differences for Dirichlet, Neumann, and impedance boundary conditions. The Schrödingerisation method transforms any linear PDEs into a system of Schrödinger-type PDEs -with unitary evolution- using the warped phase transformation that maps the equations in one higher dimension. For periodic problems, we develop circuits by combining controlled Fourier-mode rotations. For physical boundaries, interleaved encoding swaps the spatial and field-component registers, enabling a more efficient circuit construction using shift operators. We analyze $p$th-order Trotter-Suzuki formulas and derive splitting-error and CNOT-gate estimates, under the assumptions of smooth auxiliary initialization and solution-state recovery. Comparison with classical partitioned splitting methods identifies a polynomial improvement in spatial-resolution dependence for the quantum state-evolution subroutine. Noiseless circuit simulations of a forced periodic problem and an impedance problem illustrate the constructions and quantify their errors against exact solutions and classical reference computations.
